children: The New York Knicks celebrated their Championship season tonight with a ring and banner ceremony prior to their Opening Night game at Madison Square Garden, unveiling a custom Championship ring created by renowned luxury jeweler Jason of Beverly Hills in collaboration with Knicks leadership.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261020197715/en/

Crafted by Jason of Beverly Hills’ in-house artisans, engineers, gemstone setters and production specialists, the ring captures the defining moments of the Knicks’ Championship run through intricate craftsmanship, innovative engineering and deeply personal details honoring the team, its players and Madison Square Garden, the legendary home of Knicks basketball.

At the heart of the design is a first-of-its-kind feature in championship ring history: a state-of-the-art mechanism that raises a miniature recreation of Madison Square Garden’s iconic exterior with a simple turn. The innovation is complemented by a ring body that twists open to reveal a detailed miniature recreation of the arena’s lower bowl, while the underside of the removable ring top recreates the Garden’s distinctive ceiling architecture.

“We felt the pressure to create something truly revolutionary, worthy of an iconic franchise and a city as passionate about basketball as New York, while translating the defining moments of the Knicks’ championship run into an extraordinary piece of design. Bringing Madison Square Garden to life through the ring’s innovative moving mechanisms was central to that vision, and we’re proud to have partnered with the Knicks to create a piece of history that will stand the test of time,” said Jason Arasheben, founder and CEO of Jason of Beverly Hills.
RING DESIGN FEATURES

Crafted in white gold, the ring features just under 800 diamonds and sapphires totaling 22 carats. Round brilliant and emerald-cut white diamonds, paired with radially set blue sapphires, reflect the Knicks’ signature colors. Across the ring, championship milestones, individual player tributes and defining moments from the team’s title run are translated into distinctive design elements.
A LIVING TRIBUTE TO MADISON SQUARE GARDEN:

In a first for championship ring history, a built-in mechanism raises a miniature recreation of the Garden’s iconic exterior. The removable ring top reveals the arena’s distinctive ceiling architecture underneath, while the ring body twists open to unveil a miniature recreation of its lower bowl.
A TRIBUTE TO EVERY PLAYER:

Jersey numbers representing the entire championship roster wrap around the ring top. Each player’s ring is further personalized with their last name positioned above a diamond-encrusted jersey number.
THE 16-POINT COMEBACK:

The championship side features the 2026 title year, playoff series results and the Larry O’Brien Trophy. Set into the trophy is a 0.16-carat round diamond, commemorating the Knicks’ 16-point comeback against San Antonio in the championship-clinching game.
16 PLAYOFF VICTORIES:
Sixteen emerald-cut diamonds line the inner bezel, representing each of the team’s 16 postseason victories.
69 COMBINED WINS:
The words “WORLD CHAMPIONS” are set with 69 points of round white diamonds, honoring the Knicks’ 69 combined wins during their championship season.
“KNICKS IN FIVE”:
Engraved along the inner shank, the phrase commemorates the team’s five-game Finals victory over San Antonio.
“10 WEEKS”:
Also engraved inside the ring, this inscription references the team’s mantra, a commitment to 10 weeks of sacrifice, discipline and complete focus on winning a championship.

About Jason of Beverly Hills

Founded in 2002 and led by CEO & Creative Director Jason Arasheben, Jason of Beverly Hills has evolved into a luxury house synonymous with precision engineering, boundary-pushing design, and a cultural footprint recognized across sports and entertainment. What began at UCLA—where Jason first sketched and crafted small accessories between classes—has grown into a world renowned atelier responsible for some of the most iconic, larger-than-life designs in modern sports history. Guided by the discipline and ambition instilled by his immigrant parents, Jason built a brand now sought out by world champions, entertainers, and modern icons. Our mission remains unchanged: redefine what fine jewelry can be, and elevate every moment that matters.
About Madison Square Garden Sports Corp.

Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (MSG Sports) is a leading professional sports company, with a collection of assets that includes the New York Knicks (NBA) and the New York Rangers (NHL), as well as two development league teams – the Westchester Knicks (NBAGL) and the Hartford Wolf Pack (AHL). MSG Sports also operates a professional sports team performance center – the MSG Training Center in Greenburgh, NY. More information is available at msgsports.com.
